method: Built-in image_gen; three complete newly painted phone brain-option cards and one newly painted reusable complete blank card. Generated pixels saved unchanged; no crops, upscaling, seam-patching or postprocessing.

reference.name: markup(1).png
reference.inspection: Library image_file followed by browser display because Windows helper cannot apply xattrs. Red annotations identify outer gold/lotus card corners. Screenshot included as image_gen input; annotations excluded from new assets.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one COMPLETE freshly drawn ancient Egyptian educational game option card.
The provided red-marked screenshot is the user's design reference and identifies a defect: clipped/broken gold borders and lotus corner ornaments on three option cards. Use that marked screenshot as the style and layout reference, but NEVER copy any red annotation, markup, UI text, black screenshot surround or neighboring card.
Create a genuinely NEW illustration, not a crop, patch, enlargement, or reuse of the screenshot pixels. Paint a single complete card in high detail at about 1536x1344 (aspect 8:7). Preserve rich turquoise, glowing gold, ivory papyrus, softly realistic storybook Egyptian temple artwork. No flat simplification.
Card construction: ivory papyrus rectangular face fills the image. One continuous fine ornate gold outer frame inset 4% from ALL four canvas edges. Four COMPLETE symmetrical turquoise-and-gold lotus corner ornaments entirely within the canvas, inset at least 3%; every leaf and gold curl visible; no border touching or cut by canvas edges. Straight uninterrupted matching side rails and clean rounded gold joins. No pieces of adjacent cards, no vertical seam, no dark background strips.
Inside the card, a single framed square illustration at x=17% to83%, y=6% to73%, with a subtle thin gold outline and tiny lotus details. Leave the bottom y=77% to94% as COMPLETELY BLANK ivory papyrus for live Chinese caption overlay. Keep top and bottom corner ornaments small enough to leave this text zone unobstructed.
Scene style: warm sunlit temple workshop, cream linen on a table, small turquoise/gold background vessel and columns, distant pyramids, luminous detailed materials. All MAIN SUBJECTS fully contained inside the illustration with 12% clear breathing room, no cut tips, no truncated tools or jars.
No text, letters, digits, labels, watermark, arrows, circles, red ink or user marks. Produce one single card, never a triptych.
MAIN SUBJECT for this first card: a single slim curved bronze nasal hook with an ornate turquoise and gold cylindrical handle, resting diagonally on folded ivory linen. Show the complete long metal shaft and its small curved hook tip, with generous room on all sides. The educational subject is the nasal hook, not a knife. Match the leftmost reference option's subject, freshly repainted.
